posts.en:
dsh-computer-use is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Text-first computer use for DSH: background Chromium control via Playwright/CDP plus accessibility-first macOS control; actions stay pinned to the right process and window without taking the user's pointer, ships a Developer ID signed, notarized Universal 2 DMG.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-49b84f997b01af74d22b.html
